subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should channels without native grouping metadata, starting with LINE, get opt-in same-sender media batching, a broader shared channel batching contract, or no heuristic media batching support?
rationale: LINE has no reliable album id, and automation should not choose the default latency, grouping key, flush-on-text behavior, reply-token tradeoff, or plugin-versus-core ownership for a public config change.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, using shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

options.title: Design a shared contract first
options.body: Define a media-aware channel SDK/core contract before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Defer batching changes
options.body: Leave current text debounce and Telegram album handling as the supported behavior and handle only narrow channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, using shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a public config and channel product-boundary choice, and path history shows repeated shared channel/config ownership.
